title: 第二十章 有人设局
novel_title: 坟头开铺，我靠守墓重整阴阳两界
content_zh:
天亮时，梁家祖坟被玄司封了。

    白幡撤下，棺木暂封，梁正德和春桃的魂证由沈清萝暂护，等问魂堂复验。梁氏抱着账册站在祠堂门口，看着梁二叔被押走，脸上没有痛快，只有一种耗尽力气后的空。

    沈清萝把证物单递给她。

    这张纸不重，却是梁氏现在能握住的第一件东西。不是首饰，不是亡夫留下的念想，而是一张能让活人不能再随便改口的证物单。

    梁氏接过去，指尖很用力，像怕风一吹就没了。

    “梁家后面的事，缉违堂会问。你别一个人硬扛。”

    梁氏点头。

    “沈姑娘。”

    沈清萝看她。

    梁氏低声道：“我以后，还能去祭他吗？”

    沈清萝沉默了一下。

    “等阴宅文书补好，反向镇魂符清干净，可以。”

    梁氏眼眶一红。

    “那春桃呢？”

    “她若愿意，可以入你梁家义冢。若不愿意，我给她另找安魂处。”

    梁氏闭了闭眼。

    “我欠她。”

    沈清萝没说“人死债消”。

    有些债，不是还给死人，是让活人以后别再装不知道。

    她只道：“那就记着。”

    铁柱在旁边小声补：“可以分期。”

    梁氏愣了一下，竟笑了。

    很轻，很短。

    但总算不是哭。

    沈清萝背起布包，刚走出梁家祠堂，燕不归便在外头等她。

    “沈守墓。”

    沈清萝叹了口气。

    “又要问话？”

    “问。”燕不归道，“但不是现在押你回去。”

    沈清萝有些意外。

    燕不归把那张沾着白灰的黄纸递给她看。

    半个“清”字已经淡了些，边缘却浮出一点极细的暗纹。

    不是字。

    像一只闭着的眼。

    阿青刚从铃里探出来，看见那暗纹，纸身又僵住。

    沈清萝立刻扶住铃。

    “又想起来了？”

    阿青声音发虚。

    “不是想起来。是疼。”

    谢无咎站在一旁，目光落在那暗纹上。

    他也认得。

    沈清萝看向他。

    “这是什么？”

    谢无咎没有马上答。

    燕不归道：“清虚观外门没有这种纹。至少玄司登记在册的没有。”

    “那它从哪来？”

    “旧案。”

    谢无咎终于开口。

    他的声音很平，平得像没有任何情绪。

    可沈清萝见过他真正不在意的样子。那时候他连眼皮都懒得抬。

    现在他看着那暗纹，眼底压着一层极深的冷。
content_en:
At dawn, the Liang family's ancestral tomb was sealed by Xuan Si.

    The white banners were removed and the coffins were temporarily sealed. The soul certificates of Liang Zhengde and Chuntao were temporarily protected by Shen Qingluo until they were reexamined by the Soul Wen Hall. Ms. Liang stood at the door of the ancestral hall holding the account books, watching Uncle Liang being taken away. There was no happiness on her face, only a look of emptiness after exhausting all her strength.

    Shen Qingluo handed her the evidence list.

    This piece of paper is not heavy, but it is the first thing Liang can hold now. It's not jewelry, it's not the thoughts left by the late husband, but a list of evidence that can prevent the living person from changing his story casually.

    Mrs. Liang took it with her fingertips very hard, as if she was afraid that it would disappear if the wind blew.

    "The Anti-Violation Hall will ask about the affairs behind the Liang family. Don't bear it alone."

    Mr. Liang nodded.

    "Miss Shen."

    Shen Qingluo looked at her.

    Mrs. Liang whispered: "Can I still sacrifice to him in the future?"

    Shen Qingluo was silent for a moment.

    "Once the paperwork in the Yin Mansion is completed and the reverse soul-suppressing talisman is cleared, that's fine."

    Liang's eyes turned red.

    "What about Chuntao?"

    "If she is willing, she can enter your Liang family cemetery. If she is not willing, I will find another resting place for her."

    Liang closed her eyes.

    "I owe her."

    Shen Qingluo didn't say "debts are wiped out after death."

    Some debts are not to be repaid to the dead, but to prevent the living from pretending not to know about them in the future.

    She just said: "Then remember it."

    Tie Zhu added in a low voice beside him: "It can be divided into installments."

    Mrs. Liang was stunned for a moment and then smiled.

    Very light and short.

    But at last I wasn’t crying.

    Shen Qingluo picked up her cloth bag and just walked out of the Liang family ancestral hall when Yan Bugui waited for her outside.

    "Shen guards the tomb."

    Shen Qingluo sighed.

    "Want to ask questions again?"

    "Ask." Yan Bugui said, "But I'm not taking you back now."

    Shen Qingluo was a little surprised.

    Yan Bugui handed her the yellow paper stained with white dust.

    Half of the word "Qing" has faded a bit, but a very fine dark line appears on the edge.

    Not words.

    Like a closed eye.

    As soon as Ah Qing poked his head out of the bell and saw the dark pattern, the paper froze again.

    Shen Qingluo immediately supported Ling.

    "Remember it again?"

    Ah Qing's voice sounded weak.

    "It's not about thinking about it. It's about pain."

    Xie Wujiu stood aside, his eyes falling on the dark lines.

    He recognized it too.

    Shen Qingluo looked at him.

    "What is this?"

    Xie Wujiu didn't answer immediately.

    Yan Bugui said: "The outer gate of Qingxu Temple does not have such a pattern. At least it is not registered by Xuan Si."

    "Then where does it come from?"

    "Old case."

    Xie Wujiu finally spoke.

    His voice was flat, as if there was no emotion at all.

    But Shen Qingluo had seen him really not care. At that time, he didn't even bother to raise his eyelids.

    Now he looked at the dark pattern, and there was a deep coldness in his eyes.
title_en: Chapter 20 Someone set up a trap
